easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Workhorse using Pack Rat's ability by paying {3} and discarding a card, creating a token copy of it that will enter with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the Workhorse token four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Workhorse token dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Shadow, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
